castTime.binNote: The bin's ApheliosR spell reports castTime=0.5, not the wiki's 0.6.

values.meaning: Initial smite physical damage to enemy champions struck
values.quote: dealing {{as|{{pp|125 to 225 for 3|6 to 16}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to enemy champions struck

values.meaning: Sky-attack physical damage against each locked-on target (main weapon's basic attack, 0.3s after illumination)
values.quote: attacks based on '''Aphelios' ''' current {{as|main weapon}} will launch from the sky against each locked-on target, dealing {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects
values.binNote: 100% AD is a plain attack's damage; no dedicated data row is expected for it in the sheet.

values.meaning: Extra critical-strike-damage modifier on R's locked-on attacks at max rank (wiki shows it growing 0 to 30 percentage points over R's 3 ranks; only the rank-3 endpoint has direct bin support, see binNote)
values.quote: These attacks can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{critical damage|100 to 130|0 to 30|critScaling=true}} damage.
values.binNote: CritDamageMod=0.3 matches only the wiki's rank-3 endpoint (+30 points); there is no separate bin row giving the rank-1/rank-2 values (0/15), so the by-rank interpolation stated in the wiki is not independently checkable. The calc that applies CritDamageMod, ApheliosR#CritDamageModCalc = 1 + 0.3*(critDamage? * (cooldownReduction? - 1)), references two stat hooks the sheet tool could not name; it is not clear this evaluates to a clean per-rank progression at all rather than something stat-dependent. The wiki separately documents an unexplained bug where Severum's and Crescendum's locked-on attacks crit for slightly more than 120% with 'unknown' origin -- this unresolved calc looks like a plausible source, but that is inference, not a confirmed mapping. See top.json unsettled.

values.meaning: Calibrum weapon: bonus physical damage the empowered mark deals per mark consumed (in place of the passive's 15 + 15% bonus AD)
values.quote: Applies an empowered mark that deals {{as|{{pp|50 to 110 for 3|6 to 16}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}}} per ''mark'' consumed.

values.meaning: Infernum weapon: bonus physical damage added to the initial smite
values.quote: The initial blast deals {{as|{{pp|50 to 150 for 3|6 to 16}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.

values.meaning: Infernum weapon (current text per binNote): secondary targets of the follow-up bolt explosion take this fraction of Infernum's regular bolt damage
values.quote: secondary targets are dealt 90% of ''Infernum's'' regular bolt damage
values.binNote: The wiki presents this as one of two alternatives inside an {{ft|...}} (former/current text) template for what Infernum's R follow-up does: (a) a flat 110% AD attack against the locked-on target, or (b) Infernum's normal attack plus its bolts exploding in a 400-radius circle, with secondary targets at 90% of the regular bolt damage. This value (0.9) matches alternative (b) exactly; I could not determine from the wikitext alone which of the two {{ft}} branches is the current one. See top.json unsettled.

values.meaning: Crescendum weapon: additional spectral Chakrams generated from the first enemy champion hit by the initial smite
values.quote: Generates 5 additional spectral ''Chakrams'' that return to '''Aphelios''' from the first enemy champion hit, for a total of 6

mechanics.claim: Which weapon's bonus effect Moonlight Vigil applies is locked in at cast time; changing weapons while it is in flight does not change the effect when it lands.
mechanics.quote: Changing weapons while ''Moonlight Vigil'' is in flight does not change the effect it has when it hits.

mechanics.claim: Each of R's locked-on sky-attacks critically strikes independently of the others and of the initial smite.
mechanics.quote: All attacks from ''Moonlight Vigil'' {{tip|critically strike}} independently from each other.

mechanics.claim: The sky-attacks do not apply normal on-attack effects (only the on-hit effects named in the description), and there is no range limit once a target is locked on.

With Gravitum as main weapon, R raises the initial slow to 99% and empowers Binding Eclipse to root affected targets for 1.35 seconds; the slow/root sizes themselves are utility and are not scored as damage values here.
mechanics.quote: Increases the initial {{tip|slow}} to 99% and empowers ''{{ai|Binding Eclipse|Aphelios}}'' to {{tip|root}} targets affected by the enhanced slow for {{fd|1.35}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: The wiki's own worked example of the >120% crit bug is marked outdated as of patch V26.01; only the qualitative claim (Severum/Crescendum locked-on crits deal slightly more than 120%, cause unknown) is treated as current.
mechanics.quote: Values are outdated due to patch [[V26.01]].
